about: module orchestrate's domain, memory store, and transactional SQLite store mutants; each is judged by the module's tests and laws (scripts/examples -modules orchestrate).

mutants.name: orch2-skip-command-reused
mutants.rule: Reusing an accepted CommandID with a different payload must fail CommandReused: IdempotentCommandID and Store.StoreIdempotentExecute.

mutants.name: orch4-accept-without-receipts
mutants.from:
try requireUnitAction(u, ActAccept)
		try requireGreen(state, u, c.Head)
mutants.rule: AcceptUnit is refused as Unverified unless every required receipt kind is green at the named head: AcceptNeedsGreenReceiptsAtHead and Api.ApiVerdictFollowsReceipts.

mutants.name: orch4-receipt-for-another-head
mutants.rule: Only a receipt recorded at the named head counts toward the verdict: AcceptNeedsGreenReceiptsAtHead.

mutants.name: orch4-receipt-for-another-unit
mutants.rule: Only a receipt of the same unit key (repo, run, id) counts toward its verdict: AcceptNeedsGreenReceiptsAtHead and UnitKeysAreTriples.

mutants.name: orch4-land-any-head
mutants.rule: LandUnit at a head other than the accepted one is refused as NotAcceptedHead: LandNeedsTheAcceptedHead.

mutants.name: orch4-scope-omits-receipts
mutants.from:
case AcceptUnit as c:
		scopeUnit(state, out, c.Unit, option.Some[string]{Value: c.Head})
mutants.to:
case AcceptUnit as c:
		scopeUnit(state, out, c.Unit, option.None)
mutants.rule: Scope holds every fact Decide reads, the receipts at the head included: DecideReadsOnlyItsScope.

mutants.name: orch4-sqlite-scope-omits-receipts
mutants.from:
case orchestrate.AcceptUnit as c:
		try scopeUnitTx(out, c.Unit, option.Some[string]{Value: c.Head})
mutants.to:
case orchestrate.AcceptUnit as c:
		try scopeUnitTx(out, c.Unit, option.None)
mutants.rule: The SQLite store loads the receipts at the head into the scope it decides on, so its verdict agrees with the memory store: PersistenceChecks.SqliteAgreesWithMemory.

mutants.name: orch2-drop-receipt-on-fold
mutants.from: State{..state, Receipts: state.Receipts.Put(r.ID, r), ReceiptOrder: order}
mutants.rule: Apply(ReceiptRecorded) must project the receipt into State.Receipts so Fold and ReceiptsOf read it: ReceiptRecordedReadable and Store.StoreQueriesMatchSnapshot.

mutants.name: orch2-mutate-landed-commitment
mutants.from:
case CommitLanded, CommitDecided, CommitWithdrawn:
		InvalidTransition{Kind: "commitment", ID: c.ID, From: CommitmentStatusName(c.Status), Action: action}
mutants.rule: A landed commitment is monotone terminal and cannot be reassigned, relanded, or decided: CommitmentLandedMonotone.

mutants.name: orch2-reanswer-question
mutants.to:
case (QuestionAnswered, ActAnswer):
		machines.Enter[QuestionStatus]{Next: QuestionAnswered}
	case (QuestionAnswered, ActWithdraw):
		machines.Reject
	case (QuestionWithdrawn, ActAnswer | ActWithdraw):
		machines.Reject
mutants.rule: An answered question cannot be answered again: FinalQuestionTakesNoAction and QuestionAnsweredOnce.

mutants.name: orch2-memory-appends-duplicate
mutants.rule: An idempotent resend must report Duplicate: true: Store.StoreIdempotentExecute.

mutants.name: orch3-skip-schema-version-fence
mutants.rule: Opening a SQLite DB with user_version > CurrentSchemaVersion must fail before creating or mutating tables: PersistenceChecks.SchemaVersionFenceRefusesFutureVersion.

mutants.name: orch3-skip-meta-version-fence
mutants.rule: Opening a SQLite DB whose schema_meta.schema_version != CurrentSchemaVersion must fail StoreFailed: PersistenceChecks.SchemaVersionFenceRefusesFutureVersion.

mutants.name: orch4-drop-unit-accept-projection
mutants.from:
case orchestrate.UnitWasAccepted as e:
		try setUnitStatusTx(e.Unit, "accepted", sql.Text{S: e.Head}, e.At)
mutants.rule: UnitWasAccepted must update the units projection row in the same SQLite transaction: Store.StoreReplayMatchesSnapshot, Store.StoreQueriesMatchSnapshot, and PersistenceChecks.SqliteAgreesWithMemory.

mutants.name: orch3-drop-receipt-projection
mutants.from:
case orchestrate.ReceiptRecorded as e:
		let r = e.Receipt
		let _ = try execTx(
			"INSERT INTO receipts (id, seq_order, repo, run, unit_id, kind, command, head, exit_code, exit_lines, recorded_at, recorded_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
			[]sql.Value{
				sql.Text{S: r.ID},
				sql.Int{N: int64(seq)},
				sql.Text{S: r.Unit.Repo},
				sql.Text{S: r.Unit.Run},
				sql.Text{S: r.Unit.ID},
				sql.Text{S: r.Kind},
				sql.Text{S: r.Command},
				sql.Text{S: r.Head},
				sql.Int{N: int64(r.ExitCode)},
				sql.Text{S: r.ExitLines},
				sql.Text{S: r.RecordedAt},
				sql.Text{S: r.RecordedBy},
			},
		)
mutants.rule: ReceiptRecorded must insert the receipt row in the same SQLite transaction: Store.StoreQueriesMatchSnapshot, PersistenceChecks.SqliteAgreesWithMemory, and PersistenceChecks.ConcurrentMultiWriterWAL.

mutants.name: orch3-skip-command-digest-check
mutants.rule: SQLite Execute must verify payload digest and JSON on duplicate CommandID and fail CommandReused on mismatch: Store.StoreIdempotentExecute and PersistenceChecks.SqliteAgreesWithMemory.
